long_term_goal: GPT-grade general language understanding without an external LLM reasoning dependency
implemented: discourse-local event, entity, and implicit-agent nodes
typed Korean and English semantic-role edges
explicit universal, distributive, existential, negative, and cardinal quantifier scopes
coordination, cause, condition, purpose, temporal, contrast, and prior-result event relations
quote-aware role extraction that prevents inner command arguments from leaking into outer frames
bounded event, result, and proposition discourse referents
metalinguistic quoted reconstruction of referenced prior commands
fail-closed ambiguity for competing same-kind discourse referents
semantic-role and quantifier projection into existing GoalIR constraints
unknown noun phrases as local entities without invented concept IDs

architecture.goal_path: surface -> compositional frames -> semantic-role graph -> pragmatic authority checks -> GoalIR -> existing reasoner
architecture.discourse_path: typed prior referent -> bounded resolution -> quoted metalinguistic reconstruction -> same analysis path

known_limits: The parser is deterministic and bilingual rather than a learned open-domain language model.
Arbitrary morphology, deeply embedded clauses, and unrestricted semantic-role labeling remain incomplete.
Nested temporal, modal, negation, and quantifier scope is only partially represented.
Proposition memory does not yet model nested epistemic agents, evidentiality, or belief revision.
General bridging reference and broad world-knowledge inference are not implemented.
No broad open-domain corpus, human calibration study, or frontier-model comparison has been run.
The system remains below GPT-grade linguistic breadth, robustness, world knowledge, and calibration.
next_frontier: belief, attribution, and evidential provenance graphs
nested temporal, modal, logical, negation, and quantifier scope
explicit goal revision, cancellation, supersession, and reorder history
broader ontology-grounded entity typing without semantic-authority mutation
transactional conversation snapshot import, validation, rollback, and corruption tests
larger family-held-out adversarial dialogue suites with calibrated abstention
